_source: Toastmasters 8078 Competencies by Path + club purpose statements

Active Listening.objective: Apply listening skills to increase comprehension and connection. Acknowledge the need for active listening.

Building a Social Media Presence.objective: Determine how best to use social media. Create and maintain an online profile to promote yourself or an organization.

Communicate Change.objective: Gather and organize evidence to support the need for adopting the change. Craft your findings into communications that create logical and emotional arguments for change.

Connect with Storytelling.objective: Apply storytelling techniques and descriptive skills to make the presentation relatable and interesting. Understand the elements of a good story.

Connect with Your Audience.objective: Use knowledge of audience characteristics to tailor your message. Identify the ways in which audiences differ.

Create a Podcast.objective: Identify personal interests and use them as subject matter for a podcast. Assemble interesting content into a cohesive program.

Creating Effective Visual Aids.objective: Demonstrate effective application of media and visual aids. Create effective visual aids to enhance presentations.

Deliver Social Speeches.objective: Compose a speech appropriate for a social occasion. Recognize the characteristics of a toast, a eulogy, an acceptance speech, and a speech to praise an individual or group.

Deliver Your Message with Humor.objective: Construct a well-developed, humorous speech that reflects an understanding of the audience and audience demographics. Deliver a keynote-length speech that incorporates humor.

Develop Your Vision.objective: Develop a vision for your professional or personal life. Organize the proposed vision into several achievable tasks.

Develop a Communication Plan.objective: Formulate a central message around which to develop your communication plan. Identify the target audience for your message.

Effective Body Language.objective: Understand how body language expresses emotion and attitude. Recognize the body language used when speaking publicly.

Engage Your Audience with Humor.objective: Write a well-organized speech. Develop a clear message and support with humorous stories.

Ethical Leadership.objective: Identify the key elements of ethical leadership. Demonstrate an understanding of ethical leadership.

Evaluation and Feedback.objective: Deliver tactful and constructive feedback. Use positive language when delivering feedback.

Focus on the Positive.objective: Reflect upon negative thoughts that may disrupt happiness and productivity. Acknowledge the need for active listening.

Get to the Point.objective: Deliver a clear, concise message with a well-defined purpose.

High Performance Leadership.objective: Build a team by identifying skills and competencies necessary to complete project tasks. Motivate team members throughout the project, from inception to completion.

Ice Breaker.objective: Introduce yourself to the club and learn the basic structure of a public speech.

Improvement Through Positive Coaching.objective: Recognize the positive impact your actions can have on others. Nurture relationships with the people you coach.

Inspire Your Audience.objective: Present a speech in an enthusiastic and inspiring fashion. Demonstrate an understanding of the value of gaining audience trust.

Introduction to Toastmasters Mentoring.objective: Define how Toastmasters envisions mentoring and share an aspect of a previous experience as a protégé.

Introduction to Vocal Variety and Body L.objective: Practise using vocal variety and body language to enhance a speech.

Know Your Sense of Humor.objective: Understand your sense of humor. Recognize the elements of a humorous story.

Lead in Any Situation.objective: Understand why leadership is situational. Identify situational leadership styles.

Leading Your Team.objective: Identify pertinent and relevant information to communicate to a group. Successfully complete a project with the help of a small group.

Leading in Difficult Situations.objective: Analyze a situation to understand the reasons for challenges. Apply strategies for coping with a challenge.

Leading in Your Volunteer Organization.objective: Exhibit an understanding of the skills required to lead in a volunteer organization. Demonstrate an understanding of the importance of recognition and reward in motivating volunteers.

Lessons Learned.objective: Identify the topics for discussion with your team following a milestone or completion of a project. Encourage an environment of contribution and voicing opinions.

Make Connections Through Networking.objective: Present yourself as friendly and engaging. Engage and interact with people to network effectively.

Manage Change.objective: Establish a plan for implementing change. Develop a communication plan for reaching all stakeholders affected by the change.

Manage Online Meetings.objective: Facilitate a webinar or online meeting via communication software. Interact skillfully with web tools in order to assist participants.

Manage Projects Successfully.objective: Recognize your strengths and areas for growth as a project manager. Develop rapport with stakeholders.

Manage Successful Events.objective: Acknowledge the responsibilities and realities of serving as the primary point of contact for a coordinated team effort. Demonstrate preparedness for the inevitable, unexpected nature of coordinating an event.

Managing Time.objective: Identify and use a variety of time management techniques. Employ time management strategies in speeches.

Managing a Difficult Audience.objective: Demonstrate the proper action for each type of difficult audience member. Defuse tense of uncomfortable situations with an audience.

Moderate a Panel Discussion.objective: Practice effective moderation techniques. Identify panel members appropriate to the subject matter.

Motivate Others.objective: Identify different ways individuals can be motivated. Demonstrate the ability to strengthen and nurture relationships with others.

Negotiate the Best Outcome.objective: Foster agreement between parties from their current state to a new state. Understand how different negotiation styles are applied.

Organise Your Speech.objective: Select an appropriate outline; make your message clear with supporting material; use appropriate transitions; create a strong opening and conclusion.

Persuasive Speaking.objective: Understand methods for researching and supporting your viewpoint. Identify the most appropriate type of persuasive speech for your topic.

Planning and Implementing.objective: Integrate clear, concise goals into your plan. Establish a process for meeting milestones during the implementation of your plan.

Prepare for an Interview.objective: Convey your best qualities in an interview. Assess yourself fairly and nonjudgmentally.

Prepare to Speak Professionally.objective: Define the attributes of a professional speaker. Determine your area of expertise.

Present a Proposal.objective: Select key information to present in a proposal. Organize information in an easy-to-follow format for an audience.

Public Relations Strategies.objective: Formulate a public relations strategy. Display an understanding of how to use various public relations tactics to communicate your message.

Question-and-Answer Session.objective: Answer questions and provide information clearly, concisely, and with confidence. Build impromptu speaking skills.

Reaching Consensus.objective: Recognize the importance of including all group members in the decision- making process. Demonstrate a commitment to the process of incorporating feedback and ideas from all stakeholders.

Researching and Presenting.objective: Research and present an unfamiliar topic. Organize the speech clearly to maximize audience understanding.

Successful Collaboration.objective: Understand the benefit of collaboration. Recognize the personal strengths you bring to a collaborative group Place value on the strengths of other members of the group.

Team Building.objective: Create an environment that supports team success. Understand and communicate the benefits of working with a team.

The Power of Humor in an Impromptu Speec.objective: Develop a method for giving impromptu speeches and practise adapting rehearsed stories during a presentation.

Understanding Conflict Resolution.objective: Identify and explain conflict resolution techniques. Place value on other points of view.

Understanding Emotional Intelligence.objective: Learn the primary elements of emotional intelligence. Assess your emotions honestly.

Understanding Vocal Variety.objective: Recognize the impact of vocal variety on audience members’ reception of a presentation. Identify changes in pitch, tone, volume, and pace when listening to a speaker.

Understanding Your Communication Style.objective: Identify your communication style, recognise your strengths and blind spots, and learn to adapt to different people and situations.

Understanding Your Leadership Style.objective: Understand different leadership attributes and styles. Identify your own leadership behaviors and style.

Using Descriptive Language.objective: Recognize the difference between literal and figurative language. Identify the best use of literal and figurative language when presenting to an audience.

Using Presentation Software.objective: Identify topics that could benefit from the use of presentation software. Recognize and describe best practices for designing engaging and informative slides.

Write a Compelling Blog.objective: Demonstrate an understanding of the basic writing structure for blog posts. Develop well-written material for posting on your personal blog.

Writing a Speech with Purpose.objective: Learn or review basic methods for writing a speech with a defined purpose and present a well-organized speech on any topic.
